'''Staglints''' were a [[Color/Legends|blue]]-colored [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] with twenty [[Limb/Legends|arms]].<ref name="Tethan" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Staglints were introduced in [[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure|''Tethan Battle Adventure'']], [[Sue Behrent]]'s [[2010]] entry in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny]]'' series of choose-your-own-adventure books. In one adventure path the reader may take in the book's story, the [[Unidentified Tethan youngling|protagonist]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]], visits a [[Unidentified Raidos cantina|cantina]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Raidos]] on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Teth/Legends|Teth]]<ref name="Tethan" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Baxel sector/Legends|Baxel sector]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> becoming bewildered by the variety of [[Alien/Legends|alien]] patrons there. While observing a blue-colored, twenty-armed alien dancing with a beautiful [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]], the youngling wonders whether the alien is a Staglint.<ref name="Tethan" />
